blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Medical image segmentation remains challenging when targets exhibit limited visual distinction, irregular structure, or substantial variation across imaging modalities. Medical text can reduce this ambiguity, but indiscriminate fusion may introduce unreliable guidance. We present RELiF, a vision--language framework that integrates text through reliability-guided decoding. Its Reliability-guided Fusion Gate (RFG) adaptively controls cross-modal updates, while the Text-guided Skip Refinement Adapter (TSRA) refines high-resolution features using text guidance. RELiF is evaluated on radiographic, CT, and endoscopic segmentation tasks, where it shows competitive performance across diverse imaging characteristics and target appearances. Additional analyses examine efficiency and stability. The complementary uncertainty representation derived from the reliability response also shows an association with prediction difficulty, with higher uncertainty values occurring more frequently in pixels associated with segmentation errors. Code: https://github.com/SeivanTalaie/RELiF.
blocks.zh: 当目标视差有限、结构不规则或成像方式差异很大时,医疗图像分割仍然具有挑战性。 医学文本可以减少这种模糊性,但不加区别的聚变可能会引入不可靠的指导. 我们提出RELiF,这是一个通过可靠性指导的解码整合文本的视觉语言框架. 其可靠性导引的Fusion Gate(RFG)可适应性地控制跨模式的更新,而文本导引的Skip Finement适配器(TSRA)则利用文本导引改进高分辨率特性. RELiF在射线、CT和内视分片任务上得到评价,显示不同成像特征和目标外观的竞争性性能。 其他分析审查了效率和稳定性。 从可靠性反应中得出的互补的不确定性表示也显示出与预测难度的联系,更高的不确定性值在与分解错误相关的像素中更频繁地出现. 代码:https://github.com/SeivanTalaie/RELiF. 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2014-09-02.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Medical image segmentation supports clinical assessment, treatment planning, and disease monitoring by identifying anatomical structures and pathological regions. Unimodal approaches, such as U-Net [ 12 ] , rely solely on visual information, which can limit their effectiveness when targets exhibit subtle appearances or substantial variation across imaging conditions. To address these challenges, multimodal approaches incorporate complementary semantic information from medical text, building on advances in vision–language learning such as CLIP [ 11 ] . However, the benefits of textual guidance depend not only on the information it provides but also on how effectively it is integrated with visual features.
blocks.zh: 医学图像分解通过确定解剖结构和病理区域来支持临床评估,治疗规划和疾病监测. U-Net [12] 等单一模式方法仅依靠视觉信息,在目标显示微妙外观或成像条件存在巨大差异时,这些方法可以限制其有效性。 为了应对这些挑战,多式联运方法吸收了医学文本中的补充语义信息,借鉴了诸如CLIP[11]等视觉语言学习的进展。 然而,文字指导的效益不仅取决于它提供的信息,还取决于它与视觉特征相结合的有效性。

blocks.en: Figure 1: RFG behavior under controlled image and text degradation on QaTa-COV19. Lines show the mean gate response across the test set and three RFG stages, while bars indicate Dice gains (pp) over ungated fusion.
blocks.zh: 图1:QaTa-COV19上受控图像和文本降解下的RFG行为. 线条显示整个测试集和三个RFG阶段的中门响应,而条则表示Dice增益(pp)大于加成聚变.

blocks.en: Recent studies have explored cross-modal reconstruction [ 4 ] , uncertainty-aware learning [ 2 ] , and bidirectional fusion [ 13 ] to improve vision–language segmentation. However, how to adaptively regulate textual guidance across different visual regions during decoding remains an open question, as its relevance may vary spatially. Another limitation lies in conventional skip connections, which directly transfer high-resolution features without considering their relevance, potentially introducing domain-specific variations into the decoder [ 15 ] . These challenges call for selective cross-modal fusion and context-aware refinement of skip features.
blocks.zh: 最近的研究探索了跨模式重建[4],不确定性意识学习[2],双向融合[13],以改善视觉-语言分割. 然而,在解码过程中如何对不同视觉区域的文字指导进行适应性规范仍然是一个未决问题,因为其相关性在空间上可能有所不同。 另一个限制在于常规跳过连接,它直接传输高分辨率特征而不考虑其相关性,有可能将特定域的变异引入解码器[15]. 这些挑战要求有选择地进行跨模式聚变,并改进跳过特性的上下文感。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of RELiF: (a) vision–language segmentation architecture. (b) Text-guided Skip Refinement Adapter (TSRA). (c) Reliability-guided Decoding Attention Block (RDAB) with its Reliability-guided Fusion Gate (RFG).
blocks.zh: 图2:RELIF概览:(a)视觉-语言分割结构。 (b) 文本制导的精准调适器。 (c) 可靠性导解码注意力区块及其可靠性导解码连接门。

blocks.en: To address these challenges, we propose RELiF, a vision–language framework that combines reliability-guided decoding with text-guided skip refinement. Its Reliability-guided Fusion Gate (RFG) estimates token-wise reliability from visual and text-conditioned features, together with their feature-level agreement and discrepancy, to adaptively regulate cross-modal contributions during decoding. As shown in Fig. 1 , RFG adapts its fusion response to variations in image quality and textual relevance, with corresponding Dice gains over ungated fusion. In parallel, the Text-guided Skip Refinement Adapter (TSRA) uses textual context to refine high-resolution skip features before decoder fusion. The main contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议建立RELiF,这是一个愿景-语言框架,将可靠性指导的解码与文本指导的跳跃完善结合起来。 其可靠性导引的Fusion Gate(RFG)从视觉和文字条件的特性及其特征级协议和差异来估计象征性的可靠性,以适应性地规范解码过程中的跨模式贡献. 如图1所示,RFG根据图像质量和文字相关性的变化调整其聚变反应,相应的Dice增益比ungated聚变. 同时,文本制导的Skip Refinement适配器(TSRA)在解码器聚变前使用文本上下文来完善高分辨率跳过特性. 主要贡献如下:

blocks.en:
• We introduce RELiF, whose Reliability-guided Fusion Gate (RFG) within the Reliability-guided Decoding Attention Block (RDAB) adaptively regulates cross-modal fusion using token-wise reliability derived from visual and text-conditioned features and their feature-level similarities and differences. • We develop the Text-guided Skip Refinement Adapter (TSRA) to preserve fine structural details through text-conditioned channel modulation and lightweight refinement of high-resolution skip features. • We evaluate RELiF on chest X-ray and lung CT infection segmentation, as well as endoscopic polyp segmentation, demonstrating its effectiveness across diverse imaging modalities and target appearances. • We conduct additional experiments and analyses to assess RELiF’s effectiveness,
reliability, efficiency, and stability.

blocks.en: 2 Methodology
blocks.zh: 2. 方法

blocks.en: 2.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 2.1 概览

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 2 , visual and textual features guide progressive decoding. RDABs regulate cross-modal fusion, while TSRAs operate on separate skip pathways, refining encoder features before their integration into decoder blocks. Finally, subpixel upsampling restores the spatial resolution, and the segmentation head generates the final pixel-wise predictions.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,视觉和文字特征指导渐进解码. RDAB规范跨模式聚变,而TSRA则在单独的跳过路径上运行,在整合成解码器块之前精炼编码器特征. 最后,子像素提升样本恢复了空间分辨率,分片头生成最终的像素视向预测.

2.5 Objective Function
blocks.zh: 2.5 目标功能

blocks.en: RELiF is trained using the Spectral-Entropic Uncertainty (SEU) objective [ 2 ] , which combines three complementary loss terms. Dice loss maximizes overlap between the predicted mask 𝐌 ^ \widehat{\mathbf{M}} and ground truth 𝐌 \mathbf{M} , while spectral loss encourages structural consistency by comparing their Fourier magnitude spectra. An entropy-inspired term further promotes confident foreground predictions. The overall objective is defined as ℒ total = ℒ Dice + λ F ​ ℒ Spectral + λ E ​ ℒ Entropy , \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{total}}=\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{Dice}}+\lambda_{F}\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{Spectral}}+\lambda_{E}\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{Entropy}}, (8)

The entropy-inspired term is applied only to the final segmentation probabilities and is separate from the RFG-derived uncertainty representation. RFG and TSRA are learned end-to-end without direct supervision.

blocks.en: 3 Experiments and Results
blocks.zh: 3 实验和结果

blocks.en: 3.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集

blocks.en: Experiments were conducted on three public datasets: QaTa-COV19 [ 3 ] , MosMedData+ [ 9 ] , and Kvasir-SEG [ 6 ] , covering chest X-ray, CT, and endoscopic segmentation. Following the LViT protocol [ 7 ] , we adopt the same dataset splits and use text annotations from [ 7 ] for infection segmentation and [ 10 ] for polyp segmentation. The dataset splits are: QaTa-COV19: Training=5716; Validation=1429; Test=2113 MosMedData+: Training=2183; Validation=273; Test=273 Kvasir-SEG: Training=800; Validation=100; Test=100.
blocks.zh: 在三个公共数据集上进行了实验:QaTa-COV19 [3],MosMedData+ [9],以及Kvasir-SEG [6],涵盖胸部X光,CT,以及内视分片. 按照LViT协议[7],我们采用相同的数据集拆分,并使用[7]的文字说明进行感染分化,[10]用于多肽分化. 数据集划分为:QaTa-COV19:训练=5716;验证=1429;测试=2113 MosMedData+:训练=2183;验证=273;测试=273 Kvasir-SEG:训练=800;验证=100;测试=100.

blocks.en: 3.2 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 3.2 执行细节

blocks.en: The framework was implemented in PyTorch, with each dataset trained independently on an NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU. All input images and masks were resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 pixels. Training was conducted for 200 epochs, using batch sizes of 32 for training and 8 for validation and testing. We used the AdamW optimizer with a cosine annealing learning-rate scheduler. Initial learning rates were 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} for QaTa-COV19 and Kvasir-SEG and 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} for MosMedData+. The SEU loss weights were set to λ F = 0.3 \lambda_{F}=0.3 and λ E = 0.1 \lambda_{E}=0.1 .

blocks.en: 3.3 Experimental Results and Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.3 实验结果和分析

blocks.en: Table 1 compares RELiF with representative monomodal and multimodal methods across three medical segmentation datasets. RELiF achieves the highest Dice and mIoU scores on QaTa-COV19 and Kvasir-SEG, while maintaining competitive performance on MosMedData+ with only 18.1 G FLOPs. Qualitative comparisons in Fig. 3 further illustrate the segmentation results across all three datasets. To assess robustness under limited supervision, Table 2 compares RELiF with BiCLIP and LViT using 50% and 10% training data. RELiF achieves the best Dice and mIoU on two datasets at 50% and all three at 10%. We further evaluated stability across five independent training runs, obtaining Dice standard deviations of 0.12, 0.14, and 0.24 percentage points on QaTa-COV19, MosMedData+, and Kvasir-SEG, respectively, indicating low run-to-run variability. The ablation study in Table 4 confirms the complementary contributions of RFG and TSRA, with their combination achieving the best performance. Furthermore, removing textual guidance or introducing mismatched text during training reduces segmentation accuracy, highlighting the importance of relevant textual information. Table 3 further evaluates the ability of RFG-derived uncertainty to distinguish erroneous pixels from correct predictions, reporting AUROC values of 0.7724–0.8473 and AUPRC scores 3.04–5.51 times their prevalence-based random baselines. These results suggest consistent error-discrimination ability across the three datasets. Finally, we conducted a pixel-level risk–coverage analysis on Kvasir-SEG by progressively excluding high-uncertainty pixels. At 90% coverage, retained-pixel error risk decreased by 45.2%, with selective Dice reaching 93.87%. Further reducing coverage to 70% increased risk reduction to 71.7%, although selective Dice declined, potentially due to the exclusion of correctly predicted foreground pixels.
blocks.zh: 表1将RELiF与具有代表性的单式和多式方法进行了比较。 RELiF在QaTa-COV19和Kvasir-SEG上取得了最高的Dice和mIoU分数,同时在MosMedData+上保持了只有18.1 G FLOP的竞技性能. 图3的定性比较进一步说明了所有三个数据集的分割结果。 为了评估有限监督下的稳健性,表2利用50%和10%的培训数据,将RELIF与BiCLIP和LVIT进行比较。 RELIF在两个数据集上以50%的成绩实现最佳的Dice和mIoU,三个数据都以10%的成绩实现最佳的Dice和mIoU. 我们进一步评价了5次独立培训的稳定性,在QaTa-COV19、MosMedData+和Kvasir-SEG上分别获得0.12、0.14和0.24个百分点的Dice标准差,表明运行中的变化较小。 表4中的消化研究证实了RFG和TSRA的补充性贡献,两者的结合取得了最佳业绩. 此外,在培训期间删除文本指导或引入不匹配文本会降低分解的准确性,突出相关文本信息的重要性。 表3进一步评价了RFG衍生的不确定性区分错误像素和正确预测的能力,报告AUROC值为0.7724-0.8473,AUPRC评分为基于流行的随机基线的3.04-5.51倍. 这些结果表明,三个数据集的误差区分能力始终如一。 最后,我们对Kvasir-SEG进行了像素级风险覆盖分析,逐步排除了高不确定性像素。 在90%的覆盖率下,保留像素误差风险下降了45.2%,选择性的Dice达到93.87%. 将覆盖率进一步降低到70%,将风险降低到71.7%,尽管选择性的Dice下降,可能是因为排除了正确预测的前景像素.

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en: This paper introduced RELiF, combining reliability-guided fusion (RFG) and text-conditioned skip refinement (TSRA) for medical segmentation. The results suggest benefits from complementary mechanisms under limited supervision. Sensitivity to mismatched text indicates that gains depend on relevant guidance rather than text alone. RFG-derived uncertainty helps identify unreliable regions, although excessive rejection may remove correctly segmented foreground. These findings motivate further reliability-aware segmentation research.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍了RELIF,结合了可靠性制导聚变(RFG)和文字条件的跳转精度(TSRA)用于医疗分解. 结果表明,在有限的监督下,补充机制是有好处的。 对不匹配文本的敏感性表明,收益取决于相关指导,而不仅仅是文本。 来源于RFG的不确定性有助于确定不可靠的区域,尽管过度拒绝可能会正确消除分块前景。 这些研究结果促使进一步进行可靠性意识分解研究。
